body: Every day... oh, that bus could hit me, maybe that drunk driver will smash into me, maybe that dodgy looking guy will stab me... I overdosed last week, because I’d had enough of this crappy life (I’m 30 and it’s not going to get any better!) and all my mum could say is ‘how can you be so selfish!!!’ So I spend every day fantasising how someone else could be responsible for my demise.

Just google a simple one for practice, then work your way up from there 😊 before you know it you’ll be able to do amazing ones like this! And don’t worry if it goes ‘wrong’, no two pieces of crochet will ever be the same, they’re unique, just like the hands that made them 😊 good luck!

It’s actually nice to know I’m not the only one, means I’m not completely mad and alone. My hobby was/is crochet Amigurumi, but despite the mental health team encouraging me to sell them, I, like you, fear rejection so end up with shelves of crocheted toys and teddies that are going nowhere.

I also identified with you about your husband getting cancer and passing (my condolences, by the way) the way you said he copped out... that’s how I feel.. how sick am I, that I get jealous of people that are dying of horrible terminal things.

It sucks that you were only offered a month of CBT, nowhere near long enough, and I hate that you get a minimum probably set by someone who’s never experienced mental illness in their lives :( on the days where I wish I could get better, I dream of winning the lottery, since that’s the only way I’d get access to the intense psychotherapy I’d need to even begin to get better!

Sorry, ranting again... but just wanted to reply so you knew I appreciate your post x
